assets.name: Menu clássico
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE isolated French food product illustration for the approved Cogna business game, PRODUCT_FRA_MENU_CLASSICO.
Input images: Image 1 is the current catalog sprite, primary food CONTENT and dish motif reference only. Image 2 is the approved Cogna opening concept, adult editorial cartoon style and French-food finish reference only. Image 3 is the finished Japanese nigiri from ART-18, shared food rendering, light and ceramic plate material reference only: never copy its sushi, seaweed, rice or fish into the French dishes. Never copy source backgrounds, outer rings, UI, text, checkerboard, emblems or cutlery.
Primary request: ONE cooked escargot in its large warm cream-and-tan spiral shell, resting on ONE shallow oval dark blue-teal ceramic plate with a thin warm ivory rim. Preserve the current catalog motif, not multiple new portions. The whole spiral shell is visible, curved tip receding toward the upper right; the shell opening faces the lower left and viewer. Inside the opening show a small cooked snail portion in golden melted garlic-herb butter flecked with finely grouped green parsley. The spiral has restrained light tan bands and soft warm highlights, not photographic stripes. A small parsley sprig and one modest lemon wedge sit naturally on the plate at the left of the shell. No live snail body, head, eyes, antennae or animal face: this is a cooked served French dish. No fork, escargot tongs, second snail, bread, bowl or other course. Keep the plate low and elegant, one plate only.
Composition/camera: one compact plated French food product, completely inside a SQUARE 1:1 canvas, desired 1024x1024 source. Three-quarter food illustration with visible top surfaces and a readable front edge, viewed slightly from above; not a flat overhead diagram. Center the entire food and serving surface, approximately 80 percent of canvas width and height, leaving at least 10 percent genuinely transparent margin on every side. No cropped plate, shell, tray, vegetable fan, handle or garnish. Designed for final export 512x512 and contain display 250x250 with clearly separated broad ingredient shapes. Plausible adult food proportions and coherent shallow perspective. Local shadows only where food touches its serving surface.
Style/medium: polished hand-drawn adult editorial cartoon from the approved Cogna opening concept, especially its French restaurant plate illustration. Use Image 3 only for the established finished food rendering, edge clarity, upper-left light and elegant dark blue-teal ceramic material, never its sushi content. Confident clean muted dark-plum/brown contours, controlled cel shading, broad near-flat color regions with restrained warm highlights. Food has natural appetizing color: golden ivory butter, warm beige shell, browned cooked food, tomato coral, olive green zucchini, aubergine plum, warm cream ceramic or honey-colored wood. Avoid heavy black comic outlines, exaggerated childish portions, plastic 3D gloss, photographic texture, painterly grain, blurry edges, wet overgloss and noisy microtexture. Purple only as natural aubergine color and subtle shadow accent. Soft warm upper-left light with small contact shadows confined to the plate/tray.
Transparency: genuine RGBA cutout with alpha zero outside the entire plated meal silhouette, clean antialiased edges. Opaque food and serving-surface interiors. No backdrop, table, floor, ground patch, outside cast shadow, wide drop shadow, halo, glow, mist or steam. No fake transparency checkerboard. No shadow outside the plate or tray silhouette.
Constraints: exactly ONE finished product sprite, never a sprite sheet, collage of separated stickers, multiple views or UI card. No people, hands, labels, lettering, words, numbers, prices, badges, logos, heraldic emblems, watermarks, interface, icons, frame, border, outer black ring or checkered fabric/paper. No utensils, wine glasses, beverages, napkin, decorative props, floating ingredients or scattered crumbs outside the serving surface. Food and garnish remain on one connected plate or serving tray. Do not copy source backgrounds, checkerboard, text, cutlery or symbols. Preserve the primary catalog food motif assigned to this ID rather than changing game data or interpreting generic product names as complete recipes.
assets.visual_composition_proposal: Escargot cozido em concha espiral bege com manteiga de ervas, ramo de salsa e pequeno gomo de limão, sobre prato oval azul-petróleo com filete marfim. Motivo do sprite french_img_1 preservado; garfo excluído da proposta visual.
